rationale: The working diagnosis identified project-specific legal configuration, repeated acquisition, project-close churn and unproven premium pricing as the concentrated economic limiter. The redesign narrows the rules surface to one authority and contract-form family and changes the buyer, paid event, product and distribution to an embedded portfolio module sold through an incumbent ERP/DMS vendor or multi-project administrator. This genuinely moves configuration and acquisition costs from every project toward one maintained pack and partner integration that could be reused across successive projects, while explicitly preserving as unknown the partner commitment, price, demand, reuse rights, integration cost, margins, payback and renewal needed for the architecture to work.
